context.focus: Turn the researched market position into a small portfolio of useful public pages with explicit audience, intent, evidence, conversion, internal-link, structured-data, indexing, and freshness contracts.
forbidden_scope: deleting or replacing prior architecture artifacts
design work before workflow contracts pass
invented market demand, search volume, customers, reviews, rankings, backlinks, citations, or performance
mass-generated public pages or keyword permutations

definition_of_done: Exactly one anonymous public root page explains the category, audience, product value, and next action.

Every public page has one useful search intent, original visible value, unique title and description, evidence refs, approved claim refs, internal links, a CTA, applicable structured-data types, and an actual material-change date.
Only anonymous public indexable canonical pages opt into the sitemap.
Authenticated, owner, login, API, and preview routes are excluded from the public page portfolio.
Every query cluster resolves to one declared public page.
No page exists solely to target a keyword variation or manufacture apparent freshness.

After the owned section passes, append or update agent_evidence for public_information_architecture_agent with status done, at least one scoped check in checks_passed, and an empty checks_failed list. Unfinished downstream stages are dependencies, not failures of this task.
